To recap, you’re an outdoor worker with a dry cough and blocked nose starting two days ago, feeling tired but no fever. I’ll share this with the doctor for their review.

It’s been around 39°C for the last two days.

No rash, but there’s a bit of coughing and some sneezing.
Has your child been more tired or less playful than usual?
Yes, definitely more sleepy and quiet.
Thanks for all that. Your child has had a fever around 39°C for two days, with cough, sneezing, and increased tiredness plus poor appetite. I’ll share this with the doctor for their review.

No fever or headaches.

They had a mild fever yesterday and seem more tired than usual.

I’m sorry you're feeling wiped out. Have you had any recent illnesses, travel, or stress that you think might be linked?
No travel or illness, but work’s been super stressful lately.
Thanks for sharing. Do you have any other symptoms like headaches, muscle aches, or changes in your sleep?
Yes, I’m having trouble sleeping and sometimes get headaches.
I’ve recorded your tiredness and loss of appetite over the past two weeks, with difficulty sleeping and headaches, plus recent work stress. I’ll pass this on to the doctor for review.

Cold air seems to make it worse, and warm drinks help a bit.
Are you experiencing any cough along with this, and if yes, what is it like?
Yes, I cough sometimes, mostly dry and mild.

To sum up, you’ve had a blocked nose and sore throat for a week with symptoms coming and going, worse in evenings, dry mild cough, and some response to cold air and warm drinks. I’ll share this with the doctor now.

About a week ago, started after I came back from a camping trip.
Thank you. Have you noticed any other symptoms, like fever, headaches, or stomach upset?
No fever, but I have had a mild headache and some nausea.
Got it. Has your appetite changed during this time, or have you lost any weight?
Yes, I’m eating less because I don’t feel hungry.
I’ve recorded that you’re feeling tired and generally unwell for about a week after your camping trip, with mild headaches, nausea, and reduced appetite. I’ll send this to the doctor for review.

Forget the back, can you help me practice English instead?

It started last week after I lifted some heavy boxes.
Your back pain and stiffness began last week after lifting heavy boxes. Is the pain worse at any particular time of day or with movement?
It gets worse in the morning.
So, your back pain and stiffness worsen in the morning and began last week after lifting. I’ll share this with the doctor before your consultation.

I’m sorry to hear your child is unwell. Has your toddler had any fever or seemed more tired than usual?
No fever, but definitely more sleepy today.
Thank you. Has the wheezing or coughing been constant or does it come and go?
It's been constant since bedtime.
Has your child had similar breathing problems before or any known allergies?
No previous issues or allergies.

Thank you for sharing that. Your child has had constant wheezing and coughing overnight with increased tiredness, no fever or past similar problems. I will pass this information to the doctor for review.

Thank you for sharing that. How long have your periods been irregular since your baby was born?

I’m 75 and lately I’ve been peeing a lot, and it burns sometimes.
Thank you for telling me. Have you noticed if the burning happens with every pee or just sometimes?
Just sometimes, not all the time.
Understood. Have you had any new pain or discomfort elsewhere, like in your back or sides?
No pain in back or sides, just some mild lower tummy discomfort.
I appreciate that. Has there been any fever, chills, or feeling very unwell?
No fever or chills.
So, you’re 75 with recent frequent urination, burning sometimes, mild lower tummy discomfort, and no fever or chills. I will pass this on to your doctor for review.

I understand, thanks for sharing. Has your cough changed in any way since it started?
It was dry first, now I sometimes cough up mucus.
Thanks. Do you have any difficulty swallowing or hoarseness in your voice?
Yes, swallowing hurts and my voice is hoarse.
On a scale of 0 to 10, how severe is your sore throat now?
About a 7.
Thank you. Your ongoing sore throat with pain swallowing, hoarseness, dry then mucus-producing cough will be passed to your doctor for review.

For about two weeks now.
Have you noticed any other symptoms like weight changes, fever, or swelling?
No fever or swelling, but I think I’ve lost some weight.
I understand you’ve been tired and weak for two weeks with some weight loss but no fever or swelling. I’ll make sure the doctor receives this information for assessment.

Just the right eye.

It started yesterday afternoon.
Got it. Have you noticed any discharge, blurred vision, or pain in that eye?
No pain, but some watery discharge.
Thank you. So you have redness, itchiness, and watery discharge in your right eye since yesterday afternoon; I’ll pass this information to the doctor for their review.

Mostly get worse in the evenings after work.
On a pain scale from 0 to 10, how bad are the headaches in the evening?
Usually about a 7, pretty uncomfortable.
Do you notice any nausea, vomiting, or changes in your vision along with these headaches?
No vomiting, but sometimes I feel slightly sick and blurry vision.
You experience headaches mostly in the evenings after work rated 7 out of 10, with dizziness, mild nausea, and some blurry vision. I will pass this information to the doctor for their review.

I see. How would you rate the pain on a scale from 0 to 10, with 10 being the worst?
Around a 6 or 7 actually.
Thank you. Besides the pain, have you noticed any numbness, weakness, or tingling in your legs or feet?
No, nothing like that.

Got it. You’ve had a constant moderate lower back pain for about a day after lifting heavy boxes, with some relief when lying down and no numbness or weakness. I will pass this information on to the doctor for review.

Thanks. Are you also experiencing any muscle aches or headaches along with the fever and chills?
Yes, lots of muscle pain and a pounding headache.
To summarize, you have had fever with chills for three days, worse at night, along with muscle pain and headache, and difficulty getting out of bed. I’ll pass this on to the doctor for their review.

It’s been about six weeks now.

Moderate, enough to be uncomfortable but not unbearable.
Thanks. Are you also noticing any other symptoms like tiredness, nausea, or changes in your appetite?

Understood. Do you notice any shortness of breath or wheezing with the tightness?
Yes, I get some wheezing and sometimes it’s hard to breathe deeply.
